  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The workflow-level permissions block adds 'actions: read', 'pull-requests: read' and 'issues: read' to the entire workflow.
  WHY: Every job in the workflow now gets these read permissions whether it needs them or not, which breaks least privilege and widens the damage a compromised token could do (the source rated it SEVERITY: MAJOR).
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1162-1175 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The temporary files (out_file, err_file) created by mktemp are not explicitly removed when the script terminates unexpectedly due to signals like SIGINT or SIGTERM.
  WHY: Over time this could fill the /tmp directory and cause disk-space problems or run out of file descriptors on the runner (the source rated it SEVERITY: NIT).
